# Seth Hobson

> Seth Hobson is a software engineer with 15+ years of experience in applied AI, data engineering, and distributed systems. He is the founder of Major 7 Apps, creator of the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace, and author of the AI Primitives newsletter.

Currently Senior AI Engineer at United Data Technologies; previously senior software engineer at Apple (2015–2021) and Kuali (2021–2023).

Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Identity and expertise

- Public handle: `wshobson`
- Primary areas: agentic systems, applied AI, data engineering, distributed systems, software architecture, and Model Context Protocol tooling
- Known for: creating the wshobson/agents multi-harness plugin marketplace and founding the Major 7 Apps product studio

## Links

- [sethhobson.com](https://sethhobson.com/): personal site (this site)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wshobson): open-source work
- [Major 7 Apps](https://major7apps.com/): product studio — hub linking to all current applications
- [AI Primitives](https://primitivesai.substack.com/): newsletter on the infrastructure behind production AI agents: orchestration, memory, evaluation, identity, and the other primitives they run on
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wshobson): professional profile

## Products in development

- [QueryPlan](https://queryplan.dev): Learn SQL performance from real execution plans. Interactive exercises are graded by running your actual queries, and result correctness and plan efficiency both count.
- Ambient Alpha: Ambient market intelligence for shared screens. It's a native tvOS display for unattended and shared screens that shows market pulse, breadth and sector leadership, watchlist intelligence, catalysts, and portfolio risk at a glance.

## Open-source projects and canonical sources

- [Agentic Plugin Marketplace overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/agents/): multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and more. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/agents)
- [Claude Code Slash Commands overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/commands/): production-ready slash commands for Claude Code. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/commands)
- [Pensyve overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/pensyve/): offline-first memory runtime for AI agents with 8-signal retrieval, FSRS decay, and native MCP support. [Source code](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve)
- [Maverick MCP](https://github.com/wshobson/maverick-mcp): personal stock-analysis MCP server with technical indicators, screening, backtesting, and portfolio tracking for any MCP client
- [Tiingo MCP](https://github.com/major7apps/tiingo-mcp): native Rust MCP server for the Tiingo financial data API covering stocks, forex, crypto, news, fundamentals, and corporate actions
